mostWorthwhile.text: Attaching the two muscles was most worthwhile: the poses and tendon attachments showed how two pulls can move the elbow in opposite directions.

leastWorthwhile.text: Filling the second muscle covering felt a little repetitive after building the first, although the comparison helped.

surprise.text: I didn't initially understand the supporting tissue's role; the first result showed muscle cells forming bundles and passing their pull through that tissue to tendons.

arbitrary.text: The initial pairing with supporting tissue wasn't clear from the board alone, so I used a compatibility hint rather than knowing exactly how it would work. The result explained its purpose.

continue.text: I would probably continue for another chapter: seeing the finished arm's opposing pulls was satisfying, and I'd be curious how other body parts fit together, though the repeated muscle construction was less interesting.
